scenarios.name: upkeep-draws-and-loses-for-each-zombie
scenarios.why: At the beginning of your upkeep, X is the number of Zombies you control; Graveborn Muse is itself a Zombie, so X is 1: draw one card and lose 1 life. The setup trigger fires on turn 1 because setup precedes turn 1.

scenarios.name: two-zombies-draw-two-lose-two
scenarios.why: With two Zombies (Muse plus another Zombie) X is 2, so the controller draws two cards and loses 2 life.
